about: A self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager.

prs.title: Importing a recipe without servings no longer fails
prs.broken: Importing a recipe from a site that lists no servings returned a server error, and nothing was imported.
prs.changed: A missing optional field is now skipped, so the rest of the recipe is kept and servings stays empty.
prs.matters: Recipes from more sites can be imported instead of failing outright.

prs.title: Selected filter chips stay first on the web app
prs.broken: On the web version, a selected tag jumped to the end of the row and out of view. Phones and desktop kept it first.
prs.changed: The sort now uses an explicit order that comes out the same on every platform. Expense categories got the same fix.
prs.matters: People on the web app can see which filters are on without scrolling.
